messages:
Release Captain: Quick release-pulse for tomorrow's deploy window (08:00-11:00 UTC). We're adjusting canary/pass thresholds and updating the fallback playbook. TL;DR: canary traffic starts 20% for 30m -> 50% if metrics stable; pass thresholds: p50 latency <= baseline+30ms and error-rate < 0.98; p95 regression >100ms triggers rollback. Please ack if you own any runtime or routing service.
Arjun: ack — I own inference-router, will validate canary config and eviction policy.
Sara: noted. are we increasing canary capacity or just shifting traffic? @Arjun
Release Captain: We'll bump canary instances (autoscale min -> +2) for the first 30m, then revert to normal if stable. Traffic % is controlled by the rollout controller.
Devops Bot: [canary-metrics] snapshot created: https://ci.internal/runs/247123-metrics (snapshot id: s-247123)
Linda: quick Q — where's the canonical rollback / manual cutover KB?
Release Captain: link: https://redwood-internal/docs/release/fallback-playbook.md — contains rollback checklist, smoke tests, and contact list.
Mike: adding a quick force-rollback command if we need to act fast:
```
# force rollback to last known-good revision
kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime --to-revision=42
```
Arjun: saw a small uptick in cache misses on staging after the quant plugin bump, investigating (posting logs in a sec).
Sara: small request — please update routing policy so fallback routes to quantized-1 when host latency > 250ms for >30s. That reduced error surface in previous runs.
Release Captain: noted; Ops, please update policy by EOD. @Linda do you own the routing policy PR? :thumbsup:
Linda: yup, adding tests and will open PR in 15m.
Release Captain: final operational notes: no schema changes in this train; canary duration fixed at 30m. If any service fails to reach 80% of expected throughput after 15m, engage oncall and pause rollout. Keep rollback window >= 60m.
Mike: ack — I'll monitor dashboards and set alerts for p95 latency spikes. :eyes: 
Arjun: will post verification snippet and cache miss diffs when done.
Release Captain: thanks all. I'll post a short follow-up thread after the first canary snapshot with pass/fail and rollback status.
Devops Bot: deploy job queued: deploy/release-2026-03-24 #846 (queued by Release Captain)
